Rainfall Prediction System: Random forest on weather features; the weatherAUS Kaggle dataset or IMD data; classification of rain tomorrow or not.

Speech Recognition System: The SpeechRecognition library or the open-source Whisper model; microphone to text.
Simple Linear Regression: Fit a line with scikit-learn and from scratch with gradient descent; plot residuals on a small housing dataset.
Voice Recognition System: Speaker identification using MFCC features from librosa and an SVM classifier; collect voice data only with consent.
Image Classification with CNN: Keras or PyTorch CNN on CIFAR-10 or MNIST; data augmentation, accuracy and confusion matrix.
NLP Text Summarizer: Extractive summarisation with TextRank first, then abstractive with a pretrained BART or T5 model; ROUGE for evaluation.
Chatbot Using Natural Language Processin: Intent classification and entity extraction with spaCy or NLTK for a small domain such as college FAQs.
AI-Based Language Learning App: Vocabulary quizzes with spaced repetition and an LLM API for example sentences; Streamlit interface.
AI Travel Planner: LLM API with structured prompts for itineraries, combined with a maps or weather API; check output against real data.
Animal Species Prediction: Image classification with transfer learning (MobileNet or ResNet) on a Kaggle animals dataset.
Traffic Prediction: Regression on hour, weekday and weather features with random forest or gradient boosting; the UCI Metro Interstate Traffic Volume dataset.
Email Spam Detection Project: Compare Naive Bayes, SVM and logistic regression using precision and recall, and handle class imbalance.
AI Chatbot Project: LLM API chatbot with conversation memory and a system prompt; Streamlit or Gradio front end.
Content Planner: An LLM builds a weekly content calendar from a topic and audience; export the plan to CSV.
Cryptocurrency Analysis: Price history from a public API such as CoinGecko; moving averages, volatility and correlation in pandas; analysis only, no financial advice.
Resume Parser AI Project: Extract name, skills and education from PDFs using pdfminer, spaCy NER and regex; handle personal data carefully.
Credit Card Fraud Detection: Highly imbalanced classification; the Kaggle credit card fraud dataset; class weights or SMOTE; judge by precision and recall, not accuracy.
UPI Fraud Detection: Real UPI data is not public, so use simulated transactions such as PaySim-style data; features like amount, time and transaction velocity.
Fake News Detection: TF-IDF with a linear classifier as a baseline, then fine-tune BERT; LIAR or ISOT dataset; discuss label bias.
Disease Prediction System: Symptom-based classification with random forest on a public symptom-disease dataset; educational only, not medical advice.
Plant Disease Detection Project: CNN with transfer learning on the PlantVillage dataset; note that real field photos generalise worse.
Brain Tumor Detection Using Deep Learnin: CNN or transfer learning on a public brain MRI dataset from Kaggle; Grad-CAM for explanations; not for clinical use.
Stock Price Prediction Using LSTM and RN: LSTM or GRU on sliding windows of yfinance prices, compared with a naive baseline; warn about overfitting; not advice.
Fake Product Review Identification: Text classification with TF-IDF plus reviewer behaviour features on Yelp or Amazon review data; BERT as an upgrade.
Instagram Spam Detection: Classify fake accounts from profile features such as followers, posts and bio length using random forest or XGBoost on a public fake-profile dataset; do not scrape against platform terms.
Number Plate Recognition System: YOLO to find the plate, then OCR with EasyOCR or Tesseract; Indian plate formats; privacy considerations.
Sign Language Recognition App with Pytho: MediaPipe hand landmarks with an LSTM or CNN on an ASL alphabet dataset; real-time webcam.
Detecting Violence in Videos: CNN plus LSTM or a 3D CNN on the Real Life Violence Situations or Hockey Fights dataset.
AI for Video Summarization: Shot detection and keyframes, plus Whisper transcription and an LLM or BART summary.
AI Video Summarization and Quiz Generati: Whisper transcript, then an LLM writes a summary and multiple-choice questions; verify the answers.
Text Generation Model: Fine-tune a small GPT-2 on a custom text corpus with Hugging Face; compare with an n-gram baseline.
AI-Powered Music Generator: Symbolic music from MIDI data using an LSTM or Transformer with music21 or Magenta; MAESTRO or Lakh MIDI dataset.
Generative Music with GANs: A GAN on piano rolls or spectrograms; discuss training instability and mode collapse; MAESTRO data.
Image Captioning: CNN encoder such as ResNet with an LSTM or transformer decoder; Flickr8k or MS COCO; BLEU score.
Handwriting Recognition System: CNN on MNIST or EMNIST for characters, or a CRNN with CTC loss on the IAM dataset for words.
Deep Neural Network for Sentiment Analys: LSTM or BERT on IMDb reviews, compared with a logistic regression baseline.
Deep Learning for Time Series Forecastin: LSTM, GRU or temporal CNN on an electricity consumption dataset; compare with ARIMA; walk-forward validation.
AI-Powered Facial Recognition System: Face embeddings with FaceNet or dlib compared by distance; LFW dataset; consent, bias and privacy.
AI-Powered Virtual Personal Assistant: Speech-to-text, intent handling, an LLM API and text-to-speech, with tools such as calendar and weather.
Medical Assistant: LLM question answering grounded in trusted medical documents using RAG; clear disclaimers; no diagnosis.
Customer Support Agent: LLM with RAG over an FAQ knowledge base, intent routing and human handoff; measure answer accuracy.
Financial Report Analyst: Parse annual report PDFs and have an LLM summarise key ratios; check every number against the source.
Financial AI Agent for Market Insights: LLM agent calling market data and news APIs as tools; guard against invented numbers; not advice.
Malware Detection Using Deep Learning: CNN on byte-plot images from the Malimg dataset, or static features from the EMBER dataset; handle samples only in a sandbox.
Ransomware Analysis and Prediction Proje: Classification on static and dynamic features of samples from public datasets; work only inside an isolated virtual machine.
Stress Level Detection Project: Classification from physiological signals in the WESAD dataset or from survey features; not a clinical tool.
Price Comparison Application: Prices from official APIs or permitted data; fuzzy matching to normalise product names; respect each site's terms.
Object Detection System: Ultralytics YOLO pretrained on COCO, then fine-tuned on a custom dataset; mAP as the metric.
Face Detection Project: Compare Haar cascades, HOG with SVM in dlib, and a DNN or MTCNN detector on speed and accuracy.
AI Elderly Care Assistant: Voice medicine reminders, simple fall detection from pose estimation and an LLM companion; consent and privacy.
AI in Finance: Fraud Detection System: End-to-end pipeline: ingest transactions, build features, train XGBoost, serve through an API and monitor drift.
AI Assistant with FastMCP and LangGraph: An MCP server exposing tools through FastMCP, and a LangGraph agent that calls them; state handling and tool calling.
Cybersecurity Intelligence Agent: LLM agent that summarises CVE entries from the NVD and threat reports and maps them to MITRE ATT&CK; read-only, with human review.
AI Chatbot with Transformer Models: Fine-tune a small pretrained transformer such as Flan-T5 or DialoGPT with Hugging Face on a dialogue dataset; compare with an API model.
Autonomous Drone Navigation: Simulation first, using AirSim or Gazebo with PX4; obstacle avoidance from depth or reinforcement learning.
AI for Real-Time Speech Translation: Streaming speech recognition with Whisper, then machine translation and text-to-speech; the latency trade-offs.
Deep Reinforcement Learning for Game Pla: Gymnasium environments such as CartPole or Atari with Stable-Baselines3 PPO or DQN; read the reward curves.
Deep Q-Learning for Game Playing: DQN from scratch in PyTorch with a replay buffer, target network and epsilon-greedy exploration, on CartPole.
Self-Driving Car Simulation: CARLA or the Udacity simulator; behavioural cloning with a CNN for lane following.
Multi-Agent AI Collaboration System: Several LLM agents with roles such as planner, coder and reviewer, using LangGraph or CrewAI; control cost and loops.
AI-Powered Code Review Assistant: LLM reviews pull request diffs fetched through the GitHub API, combined with static analysis such as flake8; a human makes the final call.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Cha: Chunk documents, embed them, store in FAISS or Chroma, retrieve top-k and answer with an LLM; evaluate retrieval quality.
AI Voice Cloning System: Open-source text-to-speech such as Coqui XTTS; use only with the speaker's consent and discuss misuse risks.
AI-Powered Interview Simulator: An LLM asks role-specific questions, takes spoken answers and scores them against a rubric.
AI Legal Document Analyzer: RAG and clause extraction with an LLM over contracts, with citations to source passages; not legal advice.
AI Resume Screening System: Embedding similarity between resumes and a job description plus skill extraction; audit for bias and keep a human in the loop.
AI Research Paper Summarizer: Parse PDFs with GROBID or PyMuPDF, summarise section by section with an LLM, and fetch papers from the arXiv API.
AI Meeting Notes Generator: Whisper transcription, speaker diarization with pyannote and an LLM for summary and action items; get participants' consent.
AI-Powered Healthcare Diagnosis Assistan: RAG over medical guidelines for symptom triage; strong disclaimers and no diagnosis claims; MIMIC needs credentialed access.
Real-Time Crowd Monitoring System: People detection and counting with YOLO plus density estimation on the ShanghaiTech dataset; count people, do not identify them.
AI Surveillance and Threat Detection Sys: Object detection plus anomaly detection on the UCF-Crime dataset; legal compliance, privacy and bias.
AI-Powered Trading Bot: Backtest strategies on historical data with backtesting.py or Backtrader; paper trading only; include costs; not advice.
AI SaaS Customer Analytics Platform: Churn prediction and k-means segmentation on a telecom churn dataset with a Streamlit dashboard.
Multimodal AI Assistant (Text + Voice +: Whisper for speech, a vision-language model for images, an LLM for reasoning and text-to-speech for replies.
AI-Based Fake Face / Deepfake Detection: Xception or CNN classifier on FaceForensics++ or the DFDC dataset; discuss poor generalisation to new fakes.
Real-Time Object Tracking System: YOLO detection plus a tracker such as DeepSORT or ByteTrack; evaluate on MOT17.
AI-Powered Search Engine: Hybrid search combining BM25 and dense embeddings with re-ranking; Elasticsearch or FAISS; evaluate with nDCG.
AI Agent for Automated Web Browsing: LLM agent controlling a browser through Playwright; step limits, sandboxing and respect for site terms.
Federated Learning System: Simulated clients with Flower or TensorFlow Federated on MNIST or CIFAR using FedAvg; non-IID data.
AI-Driven Recommendation Engine at Scale: Two stages: candidate generation with ALS or a two-tower model, then ranking; MovieLens data and approximate nearest neighbour search.
LLM Fine-Tuning Platform: LoRA or QLoRA with Hugging Face PEFT on a small open model, with experiment tracking in MLflow or Weights & Biases.
AI Knowledge Base & Q&A System: RAG with citations over a document set; chunking strategy, embeddings and checking that answers stay faithful to the sources.
